meanings.usage: 指干旱少雨、植被稀少的大面积荒漠地区

meanings.meaning: 荒凉的（修饰表示地点的名词，指地方荒无人烟） noun. 沙漠

meanings.usage: 用来描述人或事物不同于普通情况，含褒义时表示非常优秀
通常用来描述想法、期望等不符合客观实际
可指宗教中的天堂，也可指令人愉悦的完美地方或状态
用来描述人的处境痛苦，或事物质量差、令人不满
不及物动词，可搭配to death表示饿死；口语中也可表示很饿
an element of 为常用搭配，表示“一点点，些许”

meanings.meaning: 珊瑚（不可数名词，也可作定语修饰名词，如coral island（珊瑚岛））

meanings.usage: 可表示车辆、船只的装载量，也可指人的工作负担

meanings.meaning: 装满（常用搭配load sth with sth，表示“给某物装上某物”） noun. 负载

meanings.usage: 指小型的敞篷船只，通常用桨或者马达驱动

meanings.meaning: 梭镖（可作定语构成复合词，如spear gun（捕鱼用的鱼枪））

meanings.usage: 可作可数名词指龙虾个体，也可作不可数名词指龙虾肉
指运输石油、天然气等液体的大型船只或车辆
用来修饰情感、态度，表示发自内心、没有虚假

phrases.usage: 表示对某事物形成某种想象或印象

examples.en: It's hard to form a clear picture of life on other planets.
examples.zh: 很难对其他星球上的生活形成清晰的想象。

phrases.usage: 用来表示不确定的描述，意为“某种，可以说是”，弱化语气

examples.en: The small café by the lake is a sort of paradise for book lovers.
examples.zh: 湖边的那家小咖啡馆可以说是读书爱好者的乐园。

phrases.usage: 固定搭配，表示饿死，强调极端饥饿的后果

examples.en: Many animals would starve to death in winter if they don't store enough food.
examples.zh: 如果没有储存足够的食物，很多动物会在冬天饿死。

phrases.usage: 表示“一点点，些许”，说明某事物中含有少量的某种特质

examples.en: There is always an element of risk when you travel alone.
examples.zh: 独自旅行的时候总会有一点点风险。

phrases.usage: 表示“给……装上……”，主语通常是人，宾语是装载的载体和货物

examples.en: They loaded the truck with fresh vegetables before dawn.
examples.zh: 他们在黎明前给卡车装上了新鲜蔬菜。

phrases.usage: 表示“几乎没有”，相当于very few或very little，否定含义

examples.en: There is hardly any coffee left in the pot, so I need to make more.
examples.zh: 壶里几乎没有咖啡了，我得再煮点。

phrases.usage: 非正式表达，意思是吃得非常好，享用美食

examples.en: During the Spring Festival, we eat like kings with all kinds of delicious food.
examples.zh: 春节期间我们吃得非常好，有各种各样的美食。

grammar.title: wish引导的虚拟语气
grammar.structure: 主语 + wish + 从句主语 + had + 过去分词
grammar.definition: wish后面接宾语从句时，常使用虚拟语气，表示与事实相反或不太可能实现的愿望。如果是对过去情况的虚拟，从句谓语用过去完成时（had done）。 用来表达对过去已经发生的事情感到遗憾，希望事情是另一种情况

examples.en: Two men who recently spent five days on a coral island wished they had stayed there longer.
examples.zh: 最近在一座珊瑚岛上待了5天的两名男子真希望他们能在那儿待更久。

examples.en: I wish I had taken your advice when I was choosing my major.
examples.zh: 我真希望我选专业的时候听了你的建议。

grammar.title: either...or...并列连词结构
grammar.structure: either + 成分A + or + 成分B
grammar.definition: either...or...是表示选择关系的并列连词，用来连接两个对等的成分，表示“要么……要么……；或者……或者……”，二者选其一。 连接的成分可以是主语、谓语、宾语、表语等，连接主语时，谓语动词遵循“就近原则”，和or后面的主语保持一致

examples.en: You either starve to death or live like Robinson Crusoe, waiting for a boat which never comes.
examples.zh: 你要么饿死，要么像鲁滨孙·克鲁索那样生活，永远等着一艘永远不会来的船。

examples.en: You can either come with us to the park or stay at home to read books.
examples.zh: 你要么和我们一起去公园，要么待在家里看书。

grammar.title: as引导的方式状语从句
grammar.structure: as + 主语 + 谓语 + 其他成分
grammar.definition: as可以引导方式状语从句，表示“正如，如同，按照”，用来说明动作的方式或者某人所说的内容。 常用来引用别人的话，或者说明某个动作是按照什么方式进行的

examples.en: As one of them put it 'ate like kings'.
examples.zh: 正如他们其中一个人说的那样，“吃得像国王一样好”。

examples.en: As the old saying goes, 'Practice makes perfect'.
examples.zh: 正如老话说的那样：“熟能生巧”。

patterns.pattern: Most of us have formed an unrealistic picture of + 名词/名词短语.

original.en: Most of us have formed an unrealistic picture of life on a desert island.
original.zh: 我们大多数人对荒岛生活都抱有不切实际的想象。

imitations.en: Most of us have formed an unrealistic picture of the life of celebrities.
imitations.zh: 我们大多数人对名人的生活都抱有不切实际的想象。

imitations.en: Many children have formed a romantic picture of studying abroad.
imitations.zh: 很多孩子对留学的生活都抱有浪漫的想象。

patterns.pattern: The other side of the picture is quite the opposite.

original.en: The other side of the picture is quite the opposite.
original.zh: 而另一种想象则完全相反。

imitations.en: People always think being a teacher is easy, but the other side of the picture is quite the opposite.
imitations.zh: 人们总觉得当老师很轻松，但实际情况恰恰相反。

imitations.en: Advertisements make the product seem perfect, but the other side of the picture is quite the opposite.
imitations.zh: 广告把这个产品说得很完美，但实际情况完全相反。

patterns.pattern: When + 时间状语从句, 主语 + be genuinely sorry that + 从句.

original.en: When a passing tanker rescued them five days later, both men were genuinely sorry that they had to leave.
original.zh: 5天后一艘路过的油轮救了他们，两人都由衷地感到遗憾，不得不离开那里。

imitations.en: When the winter vacation came to an end, I was genuinely sorry that I had to go back to school.
imitations.zh: 寒假结束的时候，我由衷地感到遗憾，不得不回学校了。

imitations.en: When the party was over, all the guests were genuinely sorry that they had to say goodbye.
imitations.zh: 派对结束的时候，所有客人都由衷地不舍，不得不互相道别。

lines.en: Most of us have formed an unrealistic picture of life on a desert island.
lines.zh: 我们许多人对于荒岛生活有一种不切实际的想法。

lines.en: We sometimes imagine a desert island to be a sort of paradise where the sun always shines.
lines.zh: 我们有时想象荒岛是阳光终日普照的天堂。

lines.en: Life there is simple and good.
lines.zh: 在那里，生活简单又美好。

lines.en: Ripe fruit falls from the trees and you never have to work.
lines.zh: 成熟的水果从树上掉下来，人们根本无需劳动。

lines.en: The other side of the picture is quite the opposite.
lines.zh: 另一种想法恰恰相反，认为荒岛生活很可怕，要么饿死，要么像鲁滨孙那样，天天盼船来，却总没见船影。

lines.en: Life on a desert island is wretched.
lines.zh: 也许，这两种都像都有可信之处。

lines.en: You either starve to death or live like Robinson Crusoe, Waiting for a boat which never comes.
lines.zh: 但很少有人能有机会去弄个究竟。

lines.en: Perhaps there is an element of truth in both these pictures, but few us have had the opportunity to find out.
lines.zh: 最近有两个人在一座珊瑚岛上呆了5天，他们真希望在那儿再多呆一些日子。

lines.en: Two men who recently spent five days on a coral island wished they had stayed there longer.
lines.zh: 他们驾着一条严重损坏的小船从维尔京群岛阿密修理。

lines.en: They were taking a badly damaged boat from the Virgin Islands to Miami to have it repaired.
lines.zh: 途中，船开始下沉，他们迅速把食物、火柴、罐装啤酒往一只救生筏上装。

lines.en: During the journey, their boat began to sink.
lines.zh: 然后在加勒比海上划行了几英里，到了一座珊瑚岛上。

lines.en: They quickly loaded a small rubber dinghy with food, matches, and cans of beer and rowed for a few miles across the Caribbean until they arrived at a tiny coral island.
lines.zh: 岛上几乎没有一颗树，也没有淡水，但这不算什么问题。

lines.en: There were hardly any trees on the island and there was no water, but this did not prove to be a problem.
lines.zh: 他们用像皮艇蓄积雨水。

lines.en: The men collected rainwater in the rubber dinghy.
lines.zh: 由于他们随身带了一支捕鱼枪，因此，吃饭不愁。

lines.en: As they had brought a spear gun with them, they had plenty to eat.
lines.zh: 他们天天捕捉龙虾和鱼，正如其中一位所说，吃得“像国王一样好”。

lines.en: They caught lobster and fish every day，and, as one of them put it 'ate like kings'.
lines.zh: 5天后，一条油轮从那儿路过，搭救了他们。

lines.en: When a passing tanker rescued them five days later, both men were genuinely sorry that they had to leave.
lines.zh: 这二位不得不离开那个荒岛时，还真的感到遗憾呢！

questions.q: What was exceptional about the two men's stay on a desert island?
questions.zh: 这两个人在荒岛上度过的日子有什么非同寻常之处？
questions.a: Their stay was meant to be a disaster but turned out to be a holiday: they ate like kings and enjoyed it so much that they were genuinely sorry when a passing tanker rescued them and they had to leave.
questions.aZh: 他们原本遇险漂流，却在岛上过得很舒服——吃得像国王一样好，以至于五天后被路过的油轮救起、不得不离开时，两人都真心感到遗憾。
questions.hint: 答案在课文最后一句：both men were genuinely sorry that they had to leave（他们竟然为不得不离开而遗憾）。

questions.q: What do most people imagine life on a desert island to be like?
questions.zh: 大多数人把荒岛生活想象成什么样子？
questions.a: They imagine it to be a sort of paradise where the sun always shines, where life is simple and good and ripe fruit falls from the trees so that you never have to work.
questions.aZh: 他们想象荒岛是阳光终日普照的天堂：生活简单又美好，成熟的水果自己从树上掉下来，人们根本无需劳动。
questions.hint: 课文第 1—4 句：unrealistic picture / a sort of paradise / ripe fruit falls from the trees。

questions.q: Why did the two men get into a small rubber dinghy during the journey?
questions.zh: 旅途中这两个男人为什么登上了一只小橡皮艇？
questions.a: They were taking a badly damaged boat from the Virgin Islands to Miami to have it repaired, and during the journey the boat began to sink, so they loaded the dinghy with food, matches and cans of beer and rowed across the Caribbean.
questions.aZh: 他们正把一条严重损坏的船从维尔京群岛开往迈阿密修理，途中船开始下沉，于是他们把食物、火柴和罐装啤酒装上一只小橡皮艇，划过了加勒比海。
questions.hint: 课文第 9—11 句：a badly damaged boat...began to sink...loaded a small rubber dinghy。

questions.q: How did the two men manage to get food and drinking water on the coral island?
questions.zh: 在珊瑚岛上，这两个男人怎样解决吃喝问题？
questions.a: There were hardly any trees and no water on the island, but they collected rainwater in the rubber dinghy, and since they had brought a spear gun with them they caught lobster and fish every day, so they had plenty to eat.
questions.aZh: 岛上几乎没有树，也没有淡水，但他们用橡皮艇收集雨水；由于随身带了一支捕鱼枪，他们天天捕捉龙虾和鱼，因此吃饭不愁。
questions.hint: 课文第 13—15 句：collected rainwater in the rubber dinghy / brought a spear gun / plenty to eat。

questions.q: Why does the writer say few of us have had the opportunity to find out the truth about life on a desert island?
questions.zh: 作者为什么说很少有人有机会弄清荒岛生活的真相？
questions.a: Because desert islands exist only in our imagination for most of us: we form our picture from books and films, and only a chance accident like a sinking boat can put a man on a coral island. So the two men's experience is valuable precisely because it is rare.
questions.aZh: 因为对多数人来说，荒岛只存在于想象中，我们的印象来自书本和影视；只有像沉船这样的偶然事故才会把人送上珊瑚岛。所以这两个男人的经历恰恰因其罕见而显得珍贵。
questions.hint: 结合课文第 7 句（few of us have had the opportunity to find out）与后面两个男人的偶然经历作答。

translation:
我们许多人对于荒岛生活有一种不切实际的想法。
我们有时想象荒岛是阳光终日普照的天堂。
在那里，生活简单又美好。
成熟的水果从树上掉下来，人们根本无需劳动。
另一种想法恰恰相反，认为荒岛生活很可怕，要么饿死，要么像鲁滨孙那样，天天盼船来，却总没见船影。
也许，这两种都像都有可信之处。
但很少有人能有机会去弄个究竟。
最近有两个人在一座珊瑚岛上呆了5天，他们真希望在那儿再多呆一些日子。
他们驾着一条严重损坏的小船从维尔京群岛阿密修理。
途中，船开始下沉，他们迅速把食物、火柴、罐装啤酒往一只救生筏上装。
然后在加勒比海上划行了几英里，到了一座珊瑚岛上。
岛上几乎没有一颗树，也没有淡水，但这不算什么问题。
他们用像皮艇蓄积雨水。
由于他们随身带了一支捕鱼枪，因此，吃饭不愁。
他们天天捕捉龙虾和鱼，正如其中一位所说，吃得“像国王一样好”。
5天后，一条油轮从那儿路过，搭救了他们。
这二位不得不离开那个荒岛时，还真的感到遗憾呢！
title: Life on a Desert Island
subtitle: 荒岛生活

lead.question: 两个男人在荒岛上待了五天，为什么离开时反而真心感到遗憾？
lead.warmup: 荒岛在电影和小说里常常是两副面孔：要么是椰林树影、果实自落的度假天堂，要么是饥寒交迫、无人搭救的绝境。真实情况究竟如何？课文里两个男人用一次意外经历给出了答案：他们驾驶的船在加勒比海下沉，只能带着食物、火柴和罐装啤酒爬上一只橡皮艇，划到一座珊瑚岛，在那里过了五天。
goals: 掌握本课核心词汇：desert island, coral, starve, element, opportunity, dinghy, tanker, rescue 等。
读懂课文两条线索：人们对荒岛生活的两种极端想象，以及两个男人的真实遭遇。
学会 imagine...to be...、quite the opposite、as one of them put it 等地道表达。
掌握 wish 后接虚拟语气（had done）以及 if 虚拟条件句的用法。
lead.summary: 课文先摆出两种极端想象：荒岛要么是阳光永照的天堂，要么是饿死或像鲁滨孙那样空等船只的绝境。接着讲两个男人的真实经历：他们押送破损的船去迈阿密修理，途中船沉，只得划橡皮艇登上加勒比海上一座珊瑚岛。岛上无树无水，他们用艇收集雨水，靠捕鱼枪天天吃鱼虾；五天后油轮将他们救起，两人竟为离开而遗憾。
lead.tips: 易错提醒：wish 后的宾语从句表示与过去相反的愿望要用 had done（they wished they had stayed there longer），不要写成 wished they stayed；另外 few of us 不能漏掉 of，并注意区分 used to do（过去常常）与 be used to doing（习惯于）。

exercises.q: 汉译英：我们有时想象荒岛是阳光终日普照的天堂。
exercises.a: We sometimes imagine a desert island to be a sort of paradise where the sun always shines.

exercises.q: 句型转换：用 wish 改写 —— Two men spent five days on a coral island, but they wanted to stay longer.
exercises.a: Two men who recently spent five days on a coral island wished they had stayed there longer.
exercises.note: wish 后接 had done 虚拟

exercises.q: 用所给词的正确形式填空：You either ______ (starve) to death or live like Robinson Crusoe, waiting for a boat which never comes.
改错（句中有一处错误）：Perhaps there is an element of truth in both these pictures, but few us have had the opportunity to find out.
exercises.note: few of us 不能漏 of

exercises.q: 用 if 虚拟条件句改写：They had brought a spear gun with them, so they had plenty to eat.
exercises.a: If they had not brought a spear gun with them, they would not have had plenty to eat.

exercises.q: 选词填空（element / opportunity）：There is an ______ of truth in both pictures, but few of us have had the ______ to find out.
exercises.note: an element of truth 有道理

exercises.q: 汉译英：他们划着一只小橡皮艇在加勒比海上走了几英里，来到一座珊瑚岛，五天后被一艘路过的油轮救起。
exercises.a: They rowed a few miles across the Caribbean in a small rubber dinghy until they arrived at a tiny coral island, and were rescued by a passing tanker five days later.

quiz.q: “我们许多人对于荒岛生活有一种不切实际的想法。”最贴切的译文是：
options: Most of us have made an unrealistic picture of life in a desert island.
Most of us formed an unrealistic picture of life on a desert island.
Most of us have formed an unrealistic picture of life on a desert island.
Most of us have formed a realistic picture of life on a desert island.
quiz.note: 现在完成时 + on a desert island

quiz.q: “他们真希望在那儿多待些日子。”应译为：
options: They wished they stayed there longer.
They wished they would have stayed there longer.
They wish they would stay there longer.
They wished they had stayed there longer.
quiz.note: wish + had done 表过去虚拟

quiz.q: “You either ______ to death or live like Robinson Crusoe.”横线处应填：
options: starved
starve
starving
starves
quiz.note: either…or 连接并列动词原形

quiz.q: “他们把食物、火柴和罐装啤酒迅速装上一只 ______”，此处应填表示“小橡皮艇”的词：
options: tanker
dinghy
spear gun
lobster

quiz.q: 课文里 as one of them put it, they “ate like kings”，这句话的意思最接近：
options: They ate very little.
They ate only fruit.
They ate very well.
They ate in a palace.
quiz.note: like kings 引申为吃得极好

quiz.q: 下面哪一句表示“过去人们常把荒岛想象成天堂”？
options: People are used to imagining a desert island to be a paradise.
People used to imagining a desert island to be a paradise.
People use to imagine a desert island to be a paradise.
People used to imagine a desert island to be a paradise.
